title: 1991 Azores case
summary: Steven Greer tells of 1991 Azores case, about 1991 at Off the Azores, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.
plain: Steven Greer, a UFO researcher and campaigner for government openness, mentions to a podcast host, Jesse Michels, a 1991 case off the Azores, a group of islands in the Atlantic Ocean. He ties it to his book Disclosure: An Illustrated History but gives no more detail in the telling. He raises it as one more sighting he thinks belongs on the record.
